# webhook commands

Every `webhook` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `webhook:cleanup`

Purge expired webhook persistence rows (replay keys, inbox, outbox, attempts)

```bash
bin/semitexa webhook:cleanup
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | no |
| `--batch-size` | yes |
| `--retention-days` | yes |
| `--tenant` | yes |

## `webhook:replay:inbound`

Replay an inbound webhook delivery by ID

```bash
bin/semitexa webhook:replay:inbound "<id>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--force` | no |

## `webhook:replay:outbound`

Reset an outbound delivery to pending for redelivery

```bash
bin/semitexa webhook:replay:outbound "<id>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--force` | no |

## `webhook:show`

Display webhook endpoint, inbox, or outbox details

```bash
bin/semitexa webhook:show "<type>" ["id"]
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--status` | yes |
| `--limit` | yes |

## `webhook:work`

Run the webhook outbound delivery worker

```bash
bin/semitexa webhook:work ["worker-id"] ["poll-interval"]
```
